A '''parole office'''<ref name="Chapter 19 AD">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> was located in a [[Coruscant]] [[New Republic Coruscant skyscraper|skyscraper]] belonging to the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Amnesty Program|Amnesty Program]]. Amnesty scientist [[Penn Pershing]] was required to attend daily review sessions with a [[parole droid]] in this office to ensure his integration into New Republic service.<ref name="Chapter 19">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}}</ref>
